text: Bitcoin is holding near $76k with near-flat performance while Ethereum remains stalled at $2,240, suggesting consolidation rather than directional conviction from either major asset. Extreme fear sentiment (25) combined with declining dominance from Bitcoin's 59.3% indicates capital rotation away from the largest cryptocurrencies toward smaller-cap alternatives seeking recovery gains. The $53B daily volume reflects subdued activity typical of capitulation phases, though the lack of sharp declines keeps the picture neutral rather than bearish.
